svg.title: Strategy comparison on synthetic data
svg.desc: Fixed SMA200, Buy and hold, and Walk-forward equity curves; all start at 100 over the same 1260 sessions from 2032-11-24 through 2037-09-22. Redrawn from the published daily returns CSV.
